title: Explain a project decision
instruction: Watch Sophie’s advice. Explain one project decision, your contribution and the result

video.title: Software Engineer Interview: Proudest Project — Aced

items.prompt: What should a candidate explain besides the final solution?
items.hint: Focus on how the candidate reached the solution
items.answer: The candidate should explain the steps taken to discover the solution and clarify their own role in reaching it

items.prompt: What does Sophie want to hear about the decision-making?
items.hint: Listen for investigation and other possible approaches
items.answer: She wants to hear what the candidate did to investigate the problem and which alternative approaches were considered, rather than only hearing the final implementation

items.prompt: Why can saying only “we” make your contribution unclear?
items.hint: Distinguish a team result from the candidate’s own work
items.answer: It can hide what the candidate personally decided or did. The interviewer may not know whether the candidate discovered the solution or only implemented a decision made by someone else

items.prompt: Explain a project decision: what did you do, why, and what changed?
items.hint: Use The problem was… / I checked… / I chose… because… / The result was…
items.answer: Example: Our login form moved on after a wrong password. I checked the API response and kept navigation inside the success condition so the error stayed visible. Invalid details then kept the form open
